_about: The ONE place the character lives for payroll_app. The brain (backend/persona.py) and the page (frontend/src/persona.ts) both read this file; prompts, greetings, UI copy, alt text and tests take the name, voice and languages from here. To change the character, edit this file (an avatar character, a voice that speaks every language listed (see the catalog at /api/v1/catalog.get), the gender of the Hindi first-person forms the character uses, masculine or feminine, and the still photo at frontend/src/characters/<avatar_character>.webp shown in the idle dock).
